title: PostgreSQL rejects the requested database name
root_cause: The service initializes azalea_data, but the connection string requests azalea_archive. PostgreSQL is reachable and rejects that nonexistent database, causing the integration test to fail.

relevant_evidence.why: The connection error identifies the nonexistent database.
The service creates and publishes azalea_data.
The test receives a DSN naming azalea_archive.
